name: Destiny is Typing...
source:
Number 1 web novel writer Dominik West has killed beloved magician Adaire Onyx in the hit story Not Another Portal Fantasy. Now you and your guild of fanfic writers have to fix his mistake. Will your keyboard be strong enough to hold off a certain demise, or will falling in love distract you enough to commit the same tropes? Destiny is typing…

[From [url=https://cinnabuncollective.itch.io/destiny-is-typingdemo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
排名第一的网络小说作家多米尼克·韦斯特 (Dominik West) 在热门小说《Not Another Portal Fantasy》中杀死了深受喜爱的魔术师阿黛尔·奥尼克斯 (Adaire Onyx)。现在你和你的同人作家协会必须纠正他的错误。你的键盘是否足够坚固，足以阻止某种死亡，或者坠入爱河会让你分心，足以犯下同样的比喻吗？命运正在打字……

[来自[url=https://cinnabuncollective.itch.io/destiny-is-typingdemo]itch.io[/url]]
